videos.title: Change CommandHQ's language
videos.summary: CommandHQ speaks 12 languages and follows the language you choose for it in the system settings.
scenarios: Your Mac is in English but you'd like CommandHQ in German.
You share an iPad and want the app in your own language.
steps: System Settings › General › Language & Region › Applications › CommandHQ.

moments.text: System Settings › General › Language & Region › Applications › CommandHQ.

videos.title: See the welcome screens again
videos.summary: The welcome pages show what CommandHQ is for, ask what brings you here to suggest where to start, and turn on iCloud Sync for your other devices.
scenarios: You clicked through the welcome too fast and want to read it.
You'd like the app to suggest where to start again.
steps: Continue — next it asks what brings you here

videos.summary: The Inbox catches tasks that aren't in a project yet; move them into a project when you're ready.
scenarios: An idea comes up and there's no project for it yet.
You captured things on the go and want to sort them later.
steps: Tasks you capture land here first

videos.title: Put a task off to Someday
videos.summary: Someday keeps a task without a date out of Today and the lists until you want it.

You want it off today's list without deleting it.

It waits in Someday — out of Today, the plan and reminders

A long task list needs grouping — by phase, by week, by area.

videos.title: Read the Weekly Digest or do a Weekly Review
videos.summary: The Weekly Digest sums up the week's work; the Weekly Review walks you through what's next.
scenarios: It's Friday and you want to see what the week achieved.
You owe someone a weekly update.

videos.title: Hide some projects from a view
videos.summary: The display filter (≡ in the toolbar) hides chosen projects from the Portfolio, Kanban, Gantt and Calendar.
scenarios: A project is on hold and you don't want to see it for now.
You want to focus on a few projects in every view.

videos.summary: Portfolio › Tasks lists every task, with filters and saved filters.
scenarios: You want one list of everything you have to do, whatever the project.
You remember a task but not which project it's in.
